items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 54:1
items.html: The GAR of Yetzirah are called by the name throat. And the throat is likewise discerned as the discernment of the Keter of the body, because the throat of AA is a Keter for AVI, and it is Bina that went out outside the head of AA, and therefore it is considered a head of the discernment of the body. (Item 64).
